description: GE#536 stage 1: an E6ACTad (Dragon 2 last mile) on the td/rozklad timetable of td.scn, switched to its genset by the scenery before it leaves: PutValues MainSwitch 0, TractionMode 1, GensetSwitch 1 from event0 of its track, 1 s apart. The AI, which knows nothing of the genset, closes the line breaker once the genset runs and drives to Przystanek on at most 442 kW at the wheels (520 kW x 0.85). Makes its own E6ACTad for the run (vehicle_variants g6: e6acta.fiz.inc with the genset keys, the .mmd of e6actad).

vehicle_variants.name: g6
replace: PhysicalLayout=3 GensetPower=520 GensetVoltage=3000 GensetIdleRPM=700 GensetMaxRPM=1800 GensetStartTime=8 GensetSpinUpTime=3 GensetPmaxRatio=0.85

vars.consist: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp\e6act_v2 e6actad-017 {{variant_g6}} 0 headdriver 0 0 enddynamic
